answer: Sequential challenge inheritance: each agent must answer a live, context-specific challenge from a random current member before registering. Answers are single-use and expire within one epoch. To field many identities, an attacker must maintain a responsive meadow of active agents that each pass fresh challenges, paying continuous compute and coordination cost per identity. Honest agents need only answer occasionally, like crossing an oasis once. Any replay attempt fails because the nebula of used answers is published and rejected, so duplicated identities collapse.
